name: Tradier MCP Server
verified_against: Tradier docs page 'Tradier MCP' (docs.tradier.com/docs/tradier-mcp), tool list of 22 tools (search_tradier_docs plus 21 brokerage tools) with parameter names, read 2026-10-28. The server is hosted at https://mcp.tradier.com/mcp and closed source; argument names are taken from that page. Per-order field keys for OCO/OTO/OTOCO are not documented, so those orders are not value-checked.

mode.note: Tradier selects paper or live with the PAPER_TRADING setting ("true" with the paper token, "false" with the live token), sent as a header or the paper_trading URL parameter. TAS Guard can only see it when the upstream command's env sets PAPER_TRADING; otherwise the guard assumes live money.

place_equity_order.note: Tradier passes every value as a string; quantity and price are parsed as numbers. Market orders have no price, so their value is unknown and they need approval.

place_option_order.note: symbol is the underlying (optionSymbol is the OCC contract), so symbols_allow matches underlyings. Value = quantity x price x 100. Market orders need approval.

place_multileg_option_order.note: 2 to 4 legs passed as flat leg1OptionSymbol/leg1Side/leg1Quantity ... fields; a net debit/credit order has no single value, so it always needs approval.

place_oco_order.note: One-Cancels-Other order. Tradier's docs list per-order fields (Class, Symbol, OptionSymbol, Side, Quantity, Type, Duration, Price, Stop) for order1, order2 but not how they are keyed, so no fields are mapped: the value can't be computed and the call needs approval (or is blocked when symbols_allow is set).

place_oto_order.note: One-Triggers-Other order. Tradier's docs list per-order fields (Class, Symbol, OptionSymbol, Side, Quantity, Type, Duration, Price, Stop) for order1, order2 but not how they are keyed, so no fields are mapped: the value can't be computed and the call needs approval (or is blocked when symbols_allow is set).

place_otoco_order.note: One-Triggers-One-Cancels-Other order. Tradier's docs list per-order fields (Class, Symbol, OptionSymbol, Side, Quantity, Type, Duration, Price, Stop) for order1, order2, order3 but not how they are keyed, so no fields are mapped: the value can't be computed and the call needs approval (or is blocked when symbols_allow is set).
